thread:
olivia: Quick sync — we need to finalize the launch criteria for the enterprise compliance epic (SOC2/ISO + audit retention + BYOK). Can we agree on minimum viable scope for Q3? :spiral_calendar:
devon: High level: customers keep asking for per-tenant BYOK and 7+ years retention. We can't do both at GA without huge infra cost. Need a clear tradeoff call. :thinking_face:
maya: From compliance POV, SOC2 requires audit evidence retention >=12 months for our attestations, but customers in regulated spaces ask for 7 years. We should have a tiered retention plan and a legal-hold mechanism.
ash: Technical constraints: long retention means storage + querying for audit exports. Suggest: tiered retention (hot 90d, warm 2y, cold 7y archive) + fast evidence export for legal hold. Cold can be immutable object store with manifesting for tamper evidence.
sam-legal: Legal: exports must be tamper-evident and include provenance (requestor, timestamp, key id). For BYOK we need clear key escrow policy for legal holds — don't want to auto-rotate away keys without a recovery path.
devon: For BYOK variants we proposed: (a) org-level CMK, (b) tenant-level CMK (BYOK), (c) BYOK + escrow. Order of difficulty: a < b < c. For GA I'd vote for (a) + clear roadmap for (b).
maya: Compliance impact: org-level CMK might not satisfy some enterprise contracts. We should ship a "BYOK ready" surface: allow customers to opt-in to tenant CMK in Dedicated/Private for GA, with Hosted offering org-CMK only. That reduces blast radius for infra.
ash: Implementation notes: tenant CMK requires per-tenant encryption keys, kms calls on upload, and export wrapping. We can reuse our existing KMS integration but need metadata indexing at ingest and a retention lifecycle controller. Estimate: 3 sprint infra + 2 sprint product.
infra-bot: Deploy note: created a tracking ticket INF-9083 for "retention lifecycle controller" and added devon, ash, maya.
olivia: Proposed launch criteria (GA):
- SOC2 evidence export CLI/API (JSON/Parquet) with provenance
- Retention tiers: hot 90d, warm 2y, cold archive 7y (cold archival default on GA)
- Legal-hold API to pin data beyond retention
- Hosted: org-CMK only; Dedicated/Private: tenant-CMK supported as opt-in
- Runbooks for evidence collection + incident escalation
maya: Add: acceptance tests for evidence completeness (sample prompts + expected artifacts) and audit sampling checks. Also include a compliance checklist for SOC2 auditor review.
devon: Add performance SLO: evidence export for up to 1M tokens/day per tenant < 1 hour for warm/hot, archive exports may be async with notifications. Need to budget egress cost in pricing.
sam-legal: Also require retention-change audit trail for customers. Any change to retention or legal-hold must be logged and exportable.
ash: Quick engineering ask: we need an experimental namespace for on-prem BYOK testing. Can we get a Dedicated test cluster with KMS integration? :pray:
olivia: Action items:
- devon/ash: produce a minimal tech design for BYOK opt-in (due EOW)
- ash: rough estimate for retention lifecycle + archive storage (due Tuesday)
- maya/sam-legal: draft SOC2 evidence checklist and legal-hold policy (due next Thu)
- product: flesh out pricing uplift for long-term retention and per-tenant BYOK
devon: +1 on deadlines. FYI I'll prototype the export bundle format as Parquet with a sidecar JSON manifest — easier for auditors.
maya: :thumbsup: Also want an opt-in compliance beta for 2–3 customers to validate export format and legal-hold flows before GA.
olivia: Cool. I'll set up a 30-min sync tomorrow with infra + legal + 2 SEs. If anyone has blocking constraints, drop them here. :eyes:
